It exists so scripts can cross-check that every event the code charges is declared here, and that priceUsd >= 5 x estimatedCostUsd (CONVENTIONS.md, pricing rule). calendar-year.title: Calendar year generated
calendar-year.description: Charged once per run: one full calendar (year + location + category selection), regardless of how many holiday rows it produces.
calendar-year.costBasis: Measured locally on 2026-09-29 with `node scripts/smoke-local.mjs jewish-holidays-calendar --measure`: default input (include=[major,fasts], 32 rows) = 502ms wall / 104MB peak RSS = $1.39e-5 for the run's one charged event; all 8 categories + ics format (189 rows) = 565ms wall / 109MB peak RSS = $1.57e-5. This Actor charges exactly ONE event per run regardless of row count, so cost-per-event = total run cost (not run cost / row count). At 256MB billed memory and an ASSUMED $0.40 per compute unit (unverified; CONVENTIONS.md SMOKE_CU_USD) the worst observed case is rounded up to 2e-05. No paid external API, no network.
